name: Address search (OpenStreetMap)
description: Finds the latitude and longitude of an address with OpenStreetMap data (ODbL). The address goes to getcadcraft.com, which asks OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service for you (one request a second at most, answers kept 90 days so the same address is never asked twice; only a hash of the address is stored, never who asked). It asks only when you press its button in Surface › More › Address to site; nothing is sent at start-up, no key is used, and the answer is kept 24 hours in this browser.
author: CadCraft
